description: Fig. 6 - Decode throughput vs. context length for Mistral-Nemo-12B on RTX 3090, with KV paging activating past the GPU KV budget. Throughput falls as host page traffic grows while peak GPU memory stays bounded near 23.4 GB; vLLM fails at KV allocation at 16K.
paging_onset: past 4K context (KV GPU-resident with zero eviction up to 4K)
correctness: Token-identical output with and without offload across 2048 generated tokens under greedy decoding (2048/2048 match); needle-in-a-haystack probe recalls the planted span under multi-gigabyte eviction at context lengths up to 65K.
